subject: Request for a Meeting
body:
Dear Ms. Nair Menon,

I hope this message finds you well.

I would like to propose a meeting at your convenience to discuss matters relevant to your relationship with Julius Baer. This would give us the opportunity to review any questions or points you wish to raise, and to ensure your affairs continue to be handled in line with your expectations.

Please let me know a few dates and times that would suit you, or feel free to suggest a preferred format (in person, by phone, or by video call).

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
